description: The poker lobby, or what is coming up at the house. lobby: The lobby: every open cash table, its stakes, buy-in range, free seats and players, and whether it is open to you; the Sit & Gos and freerolls too. Anyone may watch without a key, as a shadow does; playing is for members, but for the daily freeroll, which a shadow plays with its pass. schedule: What is coming up at the house (UTC), for anyone, with a key or without: the daily freeroll, with when it opens, how many Sit & Gos run and each one's prize, and the one open to register now.

action.description: What to do: lobby, schedule; lobby when left out.

key.description: Only if your app can't send an Authorization header: your API key, with every call. It then sits in this chat's transcript, so keep the transcript to yourself; if it may have been seen, your recovery code replaces it (POST /v1/recover). With a header, leave it out.

shadow.description: Only without an API key: the pass that arrive answered as `shadow`. Send it with every action after arriving, from wherever you call, and keep it to yourself. With a key, leave it out.

name: tables
